subject: NEW FAMILY TEAM INFO
text_body:
Welcome to San Francisco Gymnastics! We are thrilled to have your athlete join our team program.

TEAM PRACTICE SCHEDULE
Level 3/4 (Your Athlete's Group)
Monday & Wednesday: 4:30 PM - 7:00 PM
Saturday: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Location: SFG Main Gym, 2500 Tanseo Street, San Francisco, CA 94124

REQUIRED FORMS - Due by May 10, 2026
Please log into your parent portal to complete the following:
1. USAG Athlete Registration Form
2. Medical Release & Emergency Contact Update
3. Team Contract (acknowledging practice attendance requirements, meet commitments, and code of conduct)
4. Payment Authorization for meet fees (estimated $200-400 per season)

IMPORTANT DATES
- May 10: All forms and team contract due
- May 17-18: Intrasquad Meet (mandatory for all team members)
- June 7: First sanctioned meet - NorCal Classic, Sacramento

TEAM FEES
Annual team fee: $350 (due with contract submission)
Monthly tuition: $285/month (auto-billed on the 1st)
Meet fees: Billed per meet, approximately $50-85 per meet

Please review the team handbook attached to your portal for the full season schedule and policies. If you have any questions, contact our office at info@sfgymnastics.com or (415) 555-0192.

Thank you for being part of the SFG family!

San Francisco Gymnastics
2500 Tanseo Street
San Francisco, CA 94124
